CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.assert_no_overlapping_peer_test(p_cycle_id uuid, p_exclude_ids uuid[], p_visible_from timestamp with time zone, p_visible_until timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.peer_tests t
    where t.cycle_id = p_cycle_id
      and t.status = 'published'
      and not (t.id = any (coalesce(p_exclude_ids, '{}'::uuid[])))
      and app_private.peer_test_future_window(t.visible_from, t.visible_until)
          && app_private.peer_test_future_window(p_visible_from, p_visible_until)
  ) then
    raise exception 'يوجد اختبار آخر ظاهر في نفس الفترة لهذه الدفعة. أخفيه أو عدّلي فترة العرض أولاً'
      using errcode = 'check_violation';
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.peer_test_future_window(p_visible_from timestamp with time zone, p_visible_until timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS tstzrange
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when coalesce(p_visible_until, 'infinity'::timestamptz)
         <= greatest(coalesce(p_visible_from, '-infinity'::timestamptz), now())
      then 'empty'::tstzrange
    else tstzrange(
      greatest(coalesce(p_visible_from, '-infinity'::timestamptz), now()),
      coalesce(p_visible_until, 'infinity'::timestamptz),
      '[)'
    )
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.profiles_batch_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.role::text is distinct from old.role::text
     and exists (select 1 from public.batch_memberships m where m.user_id = new.id) then
    raise exception 'لا يمكن تغيير نوع حساب مرتبط بدفعة'
      using errcode = 'check_violation';
  end if;

  -- A master admin manages every batch; explicit assignments are redundant.
  if new.is_master_admin and not old.is_master_admin then
    delete from public.batch_memberships m
    where m.user_id = new.id
      and m.membership_role = 'admin';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

    where t.cycle_id = p_cycle_id
      and p_cycle_id in (select app_private.managed_cycle_ids())
    union
    select t.listener_id
    from public.tasmia_submissions t
    where t.cycle_id = p_cycle_id
      and t.listener_id is not null
      and p_cycle_id in (select app_private.managed_cycle_ids())

    select r.user_id
    from public.review_confirmations r
    where r.cycle_id = p_cycle_id
      and p_cycle_id in (select app_private.managed_cycle_ids())
    union
    select t.user_id
    from public.tasmia_submissions t
    where t.cycle_id = p_cycle_id
      and p_cycle_id = app_private.member_active_cycle_id()
      and t.listener_id = auth.uid()
  )
  select p.id, p.full_name
  from public.profiles p
  join people on people.uid = p.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_admin_batches(p_user_id uuid, p_batch_ids uuid[], p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if coalesce(array_length(p_batch_ids, 1), 0) = 0 then
    raise exception 'يرجى اختيار دفعة واحدة على الأقل'
      using errcode = 'check_violation';
  end if;

  delete from public.batch_memberships m
  where m.user_id = p_user_id
    and m.membership_role = 'admin'
    and not (m.batch_id = any (p_batch_ids));

  insert into public.batch_memberships (batch_id, user_id, membership_role, created_by)
  select distinct b.batch_id, p_user_id, 'admin', p_actor
  from unnest(p_batch_ids) as b(batch_id)
  on conflict (batch_id, user_id) do nothing;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_next_cycle(p_batch_id uuid, p_today date, p_actor uuid, p_expected_cycle_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_current public.cycles;
  v_new     public.cycles;
  v_next    integer;
begin
  -- Serialize concurrent resets of the same batch.
  perform 1
  from public.batches b
  where b.id = p_batch_id
    and b.archived_at is null
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'الدفعة غير موجودة' using errcode = 'no_data_found';
  end if;

  select c.* into v_current
  from public.cycles c
  where c.batch_id = p_batch_id
    and c.status = 'active'
  order by c.cycle_number desc
  limit 1
  for update;

  -- The cycle the admin was looking at must belong to THIS batch and
  -- still be its active cycle.
  if p_expected_cycle_id is not null
     and (v_current.id is null or v_current.id <> p_expected_cycle_id) then
    raise exception 'تغيّرت الدورة الحالية لهذه الدفعة. يرجى تحديث الصفحة والمحاولة مرة أخرى'
      using errcode = 'check_violation';
  end if;

  if v_current.id is not null then
    -- 1. Close an open pause so the archived history is complete.
    update public.program_pauses
    set resumed_on = p_today
    where cycle_id = v_current.id
      and resumed_on is null;

    -- 2. Archive the current cycle (its logs stay attached to it).
    update public.cycles
    set status = 'archived',
        ended_on = p_today
    where id = v_current.id;

    -- 3. Unpublish this batch's current daily thought (kept as history).
    update public.daily_thoughts
    set is_published = false
    where batch_id = p_batch_id
      and is_published;

    -- 4. Finish this cycle's peer tests (results stay as history).
    update public.peer_test_attempts
    set status = 'cancelled'
    where status = 'in_progress'
      and test_id in (select t.id from public.peer_tests t where t.cycle_id = v_current.id);

    update public.peer_tests
    set status = 'finished', finished_at = now(), updated_at = now()
    where cycle_id = v_current.id
      and status <> 'finished';
  end if;

  select coalesce(max(c.cycle_number), 0) + 1
  into v_next
  from public.cycles c
  where c.batch_id = p_batch_id;

  -- 5. Create the new active cycle.
  insert into public.cycles (batch_id, cycle_number, name, starts_on, status, created_by)
  values (p_batch_id, v_next, 'الدورة ' || v_next, p_today, 'active', p_actor)
  returning * into v_new;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'previous_cycle_id', v_current.id,
    'previous_cycle_number', v_current.cycle_number,
    'cycle', to_jsonb(v_new)
  );
end;
